value.rationale: The source identifies whether equilibrium-profile asymmetry suffices for exact rectification as a motivated gap, but studies nonlinear response by approximation. A single interior defect in the shortest nonsymmetric open chain is a physically natural test of that gap, not an arbitrary parameter slice. The exact all-contrast sign theorem rules out cancellation and provides a minimal device-level benchmark against approximations, while the four-site threshold follows from reflection obstruction at shorter lengths. It does not claim a general thermodynamic-limit result.
